lines.3: I've spotted her in town again.
lines.4: What does she do, wandering around town at this hour all the time?
lines.5: ...I'll watch her from a distance for a bit.
lines.6: Her harshness wore me out, but now I'm curious what a girl like her normally gets up to.
lines.7: Don't tell me she's selling herself or something?
lines.8: No. With her personality, there is no way she would do that.
lines.12: She is just standing there, idly watching the town.
lines.13: If she kept checking the time, I would assume she was meeting someone, but there is no sign of that at all.
lines.14: 「...I don't get it. What's going through her head?」
lines.15: Or is she just that bored?
lines.16: I finally get tired of watching and am about to leave when...
lines.19: 「I'm talking to you, the gorgeous lady with the long hair.」
lines.20: 「You've been standing here doing nothing for a while. If you're free, wanna come hang out with us? We were just looking for some girls.」
lines.25: 「Hey, miss. Why don't we talk over there?」
lines.28: 「That feisty attitude makes her even better! Hey, Taku, what's wrong? Thought you were the master of picking up girls. You're blowing it!」
lines.29: 「Idiot, I'm just getting started. Come on, we've got a good-looking guy in a band too. At least come talk to us.」
lines.30: 「If there aren't any good-looking guys, you can just leave, YO!」
lines.33: 「Hey, you bought these clothes in Dobuzaka, right? Whoa, this pattern is really hard to find.」
lines.34: The man is an ordinary pickup artist.
lines.35: He isn't violent or anything. Just persistent.
lines.36: But then he touches Yashi's clothes--her body.
lines.39: Kicked hard in the shin, the man rolls around in agony.
lines.41: 「You bitch, don't screw with us, YO! You didn't have to kick him out of nowhere, YO!」
lines.42: Now they are openly harassing her.
lines.43: Why do guys like that always fly into a one-sided rage?
lines.44: Well, I can leave her to it.
lines.45: A girl like her will be fine.
lines.46: I am a little worried, though. Letting adrenaline carry you away is foolish.
